title: Hongdie
summary: Zhou Wutai tells Wang Lin the Alliance's pleas for help were refused by every neighbouring level-4 country, because the war is really about Hongdie, a Snow Region woman with a never-before-seen Five Spirits Body who reached peak Soul Formation in a hundred years without pills. The Vermilion Bird Country invited her to join, and her one condition was that the Snow Region become a level-5 cultivation country on new land, which she chose to be the Four Faction Alliance's; the Rain Cauldron then turned up in Alliance territory as the pretext. A year later the Snow Region arrives and refuses a truce, and Qing Fu, Zhou Yun and the other Alliance elders burn their lifespans in the Nine Sons Killing Formation, destroy Hongdie's body and call up the Country-Protecting Sky Dragon. Wang Lin goes after the wounded earth spirit of her five spirits to complete the five elements of the Heaven Defying Bead, but a disciple of Qing Song arrives to claim it too. He then finds hidden ice statues that form an Ice and Snow Formation over the whole Alliance, and Hongdie, still alive, asks the Vermilion Bird Country's envoy to kill the Sky Dragon.
events: Zhou Wutai explains why no country will help the Alliance
Hongdie's Five Spirits Body and her bargain with the Vermilion Bird Country are revealed
A year later the Snow Region attacks and refuses a truce
The Alliance's elders use the Nine Sons Killing Formation and destroy Hongdie's body
The Country-Protecting Sky Dragon rises to defend the Alliance
Wang Lin hunts the earth spirit; a Baiyun disciple of Qing Song competes for it
Hidden ice statues form an Ice and Snow Formation; Hongdie calls on the Vermilion Bird envoy
cultivation: Hongdie: Soul Formation great perfection. Qing Fu and Mo Shan: mid Soul Formation. Zhou Yun and Wu Huichu: late Soul Formation. The Snow Region brings 36 Soul Formation cultivators, four of them late stage.
